summary: Enhance your sales skills with our comprehensive course on negotiation and client relationship management. Boost your success and build lasting connections.
lede: Sales negotiation training gives sales professionals a structured way to qualify opportunities and prepare conversations that protect client value. Learners practise consultative discovery, opportunity qualification, value propositions, BATNA and ZOPA negotiation planning, objection handling, and client account follow-up. The course also introduces pipeline review and AI-assisted lead research, while advanced CRM automation and enterprise account governance receive an operational introduction rather than implementation-level treatment.
audienceIntro: Sales negotiation training suits professionals who influence buying decisions, manage revenue opportunities, or protect client value after the contract is signed. It supports foundation to intermediate learners who want a common commercial method without requiring previous certification or advanced sales technology skills.
modules: Sales Performance and Client Growth Reporting
prerequisites: You should have basic exposure to customer-facing work, sales activity, account support, procurement, or commercial operations. No prior certification is required, and no coding or programming is required for completion. Bring a sanitized example of an opportunity, account, proposal, or client challenge if available. The exercises use spreadsheet-style templates and CRM examples, so advanced software access is not necessary.
